page: Google Cloud Platform z4d-highmem-32-standardlssd is a storage-optimized virtual machine belonging to the z4d server family. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture, paired with 252.0 GB of system memory. This configuration provides approximately 7.88 GB of RAM per core, positioning it near memory-optimized thresholds while maintaining a strong focus on high-capacity local storage.

The server is equipped with 7516 GB of local NVMe SSD storage, distributed across local SSD drives. This high-capacity local storage is bundled directly with the instance, offering low-latency data access for I/O-intensive workloads. There are zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses included with this instance, and no GPU accelerators are present in this configuration.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the instance offers a dense allocation of local NVMe storage and system memory relative to its 32 dedicated vCPUs, making it a specialized option for workloads requiring high resource density without the overhead of external storage attachments. This hardware profile is suited for large-scale databases, high-throughput transactional systems, and data-intensive analytical workloads that require rapid local read and write operations.
